instruction: Update the background of slide one to be solid light blue.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

The evaluator checks if the first slide has a solid fill background with the expected light blue color. Custom getter extracts the background color RGB values, and custom metric compares against expected with 10-unit tolerance for minor variations.
